description: Located in the established hillside community of Whiskey Springs, this two-bedroom, two-bath condominium offers a well-balanced combination of comfort, functionality, and setting. Surrounded by natural landscape and set just above the waterfront, the home enjoys a quiet, residential atmosphere while remaining within easy reach of all that Sausalito has to offer.  The floor plan is thoughtfully designed, with a spacious living area that connects seamlessly to the dining space, creating an open yet defined layout suited for both everyday living and entertaining. Large windows invite natural light into the main living areas, enhancing the sense of space and connection to the outdoors. A fireplace anchors the living room, adding warmth and character. The kitchen is efficiently arranged and updated with new stainless steel appliances, offering both functionality and a clean, modern aesthetic. Luxury vinyl flooring runs throughout, providing durability with a refined finish.  Both bedrooms are well-proportioned en suites, each with its own private bath, creating a flexible layout ideal for guests, shared living, or a dedicated office. The separation between the two suites enhances privacy and livability. The home features two outdoor patios, extending the living space and offering areas for relaxation or casual dining, with a connection to the surrounding greenery.  Additional features include in-unit laundry, ample storage, two outdoor parking spaces, and additional storage on site. The Whiskey Springs community is known for its mature landscaping, walking paths, and proximity to waterfront access, creating a lifestyle that feels both relaxed and connected. Conveniently located near downtown Sausalito, shopping, dining, and commuter routes, this home offers an opportunity to enjoy Marin County living with close access to San Francisco. A practical and inviting residence in a consistently desirable location.
